name: strix
description: Strix runs AI penetration tests and PR security reviews against your web apps, APIs, and repositories. List scans and open vulnerabilities by severity, pull a finding's evidence and remediation steps into a code fix, update its status, retest it, or export it to Jira or Linear. Start scans and schedules against verified assets and check supply-chain findings and analytics. Read-only tools have no side effects. Scans spend credits and send traffic to your targets.
